wiki.title: Lydia Edwards
wiki.extract: Lydia Marie Edwards (born December 13, 1981) is an American attorney and politician. She served as a member of the Boston City Council from the 1st district from 2018 to 2022 and has served as a member of the Massachusetts Senate from the 1st Suffolk and Middlesex district since 2022. She resigned from the Boston City Council at the end of April 2022.
